property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that does not revert, C.transfer(...) always completes and returns true; the mutant returns false causing the observable return value to differ for some inputs.

For any inputs, the reference C.transfer always returns true (when it does not revert); the mutant can return false by returning the success flag of the first external call, thus violating this rule for some inputs where the first low-level call fails but subsequent ones (or the loop) still succeed or at least do not cause the whole call to revert.

For any inputs with a non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) never returns false when it completes (it always returns true); the mutant may return the boolean success of the first low-level call and thus can return false for some inputs where the first call fails, violating the rule.
